import json, resource, shutil, subprocess, sys, time
from pathlib import Path
if len(sys.argv) not in (4,5): raise SystemExit('usage: run_one.py binary output-dir label [full]')
binary=Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve(); root=Path(sys.argv[2]).resolve(); label=sys.argv[3]; root.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
full=len(sys.argv)==5 and sys.argv[4]=='full'
mesh=Path('outputs/native-flow/sst-normal-refinement/midpoint/mesh.cm2d').resolve(); prefix=root/'flow'
cmd=[str(binary),str(mesh),str(prefix),'flatplate-sweep','--nu','2e-7','--speed','1','--inlet-k','2.25e-7','--inlet-omega','125','--leading-edge','0','--max-iterations',('20000' if full else '100'),'--max-seconds',('540' if full else '90'),'--completion-updates','500','--scalar-preconditioner','ilu0','--pressure-preconditioner','aggregation']
start=time.monotonic(); samples=[]; timeout=False; floor=int(1.5*1024**3)
with (root/'stdout.log').open('wb') as out,(root/'stderr.log').open('wb') as err:
 p=subprocess.Popen(cmd,stdout=out,stderr=err)
while True:
  rc=p.poll(); elapsed=time.monotonic()-start; free=shutil.disk_usage(root).free;samples.append({'elapsedSeconds':elapsed,'diskFreeBytes':free})
  if free<floor:p.kill();p.wait();rc=p.returncode;break
  if rc is not None:break
  if elapsed>=(600 if full else 120):timeout=True;p.kill();p.wait();rc=p.returncode;break
  time.sleep(2)
end=time.monotonic(); child=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN).ru_maxrss
(root/'runtime.json').write_text(json.dumps({'label':label,'binary':str(binary),'command':cmd,'runtimeSeconds':end-start,'exitCode':rc,'timeout':timeout,'peakRssBytes':child,'peakRssSource':'resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN.ru_maxrss','liveRssGuardActive':False,'diskFloorBytes':floor,'samples':samples},indent=2)+'\n')
sys.exit(124 if timeout else (rc if rc is not None else 1))

import csv,hashlib,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.collections import PolyCollection
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path('tools/verification').resolve()))
import verify_native_flow as native
study=json.loads(Path('artifacts/current/native-sst-workspace.json').read_text())
def checked(record):
 p=Path(record['path']);assert hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==record['sha256'];return p
for r in study['runs'].values():
 for f in r['files']:checked(f)
mesh=native.read_cm2d(checked(study['mesh']))
fig,axes=plt.subplots(2,2,figsize=(12,8),layout='constrained')
polygons=[]
for c in mesh.cells:
 points=[mesh.vertices[i] for i in c.vertices]
 if min(x for x,y in points)<1 and max(x for x,y in points)>.95 and min(y for x,y in points)<.003:polygons.append(points)
axes[0,0].add_collection(PolyCollection(polygons,facecolors='#f1f5f7',edgecolors='#688291',linewidths=.6))
axes[0,0].set(xlim=(.95,1),ylim=(0,.003),xlabel='x [m]',ylabel='y [m]',title='Actual 24,000-cell mesh (vertical zoom)')
means=study['fixedWorkMeans']
for i,key in enumerate(['before','after']):
 total=means[key]['nativeSeconds'];setup=means[key]['scalarSetupSeconds']
 axes[0,1].bar(i,setup,color='#9b7a4c',label='Scalar solve setup' if i==0 else None)
 axes[0,1].bar(i,total-setup,bottom=setup,color='#c7d2d9',label='Other work' if i==0 else None)
 axes[0,1].text(i,total+.3,f'{total:.2f} s',ha='center')
axes[0,1].set(xticks=[0,1],xticklabels=['Before','Workspace reuse'],ylabel='Native solve time [s]',title='100 steps: ABBA mean timings')
axes[0,1].set_ylim(0,max(v['nativeSeconds'] for v in means.values())*1.15)
axes[0,1].legend(fontsize=9);axes[0,1].grid(axis='y',alpha=.15)
full=study['runs'].get('after-full')
if full and 'diagnostics' in full:
 hist=next(f for f in full['files'] if f['path'].endswith('.history.csv'))
 with checked(hist).open() as f:rows=list(csv.DictReader(f))
 for key,label,color in [('momentumResidual','Momentum','#367c92'),('kCellResidual','k local','#a58142'),('omegaCellResidual','omega local','#8b6998')]:
  axes[1,0].semilogy([int(r['iteration']) for r in rows],[float(r[key]) for r in rows],label=label,color=color)
 axes[1,0].axhline(1e-7,ls=':',color='#367c92',lw=1);axes[1,0].axhline(1e-9,ls=':',color='#666',lw=1)
 axes[1,0].set(xlabel='SIMPLE iteration',ylabel='Residual (different original definitions)',title='Full-run convergence history')
 axes[1,0].legend(fontsize=9);axes[1,0].grid(alpha=.15)
else:axes[1,0].axis('off')
axes[1,1].axis('off')
lines=['Same numerical equations and stopping limits.','Sparse structure/storage reused; coefficients rebuilt.','No stale factors or hidden fallback.','']
if full and 'diagnostics' in full:
 d=full['diagnostics'];s=d['performance']['scalarSolves']
 lines += [f"Full run: {d['stopReason']}; {d['iterations']:,} steps",f"Native time: {d['solveSeconds']:.2f} s",'Independent equation audit: '+('PASS' if full.get('audit',{}).get('valid') else 'NOT ACCEPTED'),'',f"Scalar graph builds: {s['patternBuilds']:,}",f"Scalar graph reuses: {s.get('patternReuses',0):,}"]
 if 'fullComparison' in study:
  same=all(v['identical'] for v in study['fullComparison']['byteComparison'].values())
  b=study['fullComparison']['baselineDiagnostics']
  lines += [f"Earlier full run: {b['solveSeconds']:.2f} s",'', 'Cells / faces / history byte-identical: '+('YES' if same else 'NO')]
lines += ['','Physical accuracy is unchanged by this optimization.']
axes[1,1].text(.02,.98,'\n'.join(lines),va='top',fontsize=10.5,linespacing=1.45)
fig.suptitle('SST-2003m | Re_plate = 10 million | Explicit sparse workspace reuse',fontsize=15)
fig.supxlabel('Local serial macOS observations. Fixed-work timing is not convergence; full-run timing has one observation per version.',fontsize=10)
fig.savefig('artifacts/current/native-sst-workspace.png',dpi=150)
